audit.why: 54.12% over 170 Emerald+ games at difficulty 7.5/10 — a lane you win and a game you can still lose. Tryndamere owns Level 1 and the 2+ item split, Heimerdinger owns everything between.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows disagreed with the packet and their own why-text: whys[0] says his level-1 gap-close wins first contact but the chart said Heimerdinger; whys[3] says you zone him off CS entirely but said Skill; whys[5] says the architecture war stays yours but said Skill; whys[6] says close the game before this arrives 'or he takes it' but said Heimerdinger.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Tryndamere / Heimerdinger x5 / Tryndamere, proposed as matched full+content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d were template filler with no numbers, and the '~5s' figure for Undying Rage is asserted in three content fields without a source in the kit file. Spinning Slash's cooldown — the number that decides whether he can enter your nest at all — appeared nowhere.
audit.corrected: Undying Rage is 120/100/80s and prevents death outright, so burst into it is wasted; Bloodlust is a flat 12s heal off Fury, which is what anti-heal is actually fighting; Spinning Slash is 650 range on 12/11/10/9/8s and is both his entry and his exit, so a commit with it down is a dead melee inside three turrets.

audit.why: The page correctly makes the grenade the held cooldown rather than poke; added Spinning Slash's 8-12s so the bait timing is concrete.

edits.before: Upgraded E or W deletes his all-in — choose per fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Tryndamere's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: UPGRADE!!! widens the grenade so it catches him even through Spinning Slash (8-12s) — your hardest commit window of the lane.

edits.before: Unkillable 5s. Kite it out. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Undying Rage is 80-120s and he can't die during it — kite, don't burst.

notes: suspectNames flagged "Mocking Shout's" in wants.foe[1] — false positive, that is the correct name for Tryndamere's W. Left alone. Unverified figure left in place rather than repeated: whys[6], spikes[3].text and 'late' all state Undying Rage lasts '~5s'. Riot's text in the kit file gives no duration, so I did not carry that number into any new text and wrote the ultimate's cooldown (120/100/80s) instead, which is sourced. If the 5s duration is confirmed it is fine where it stands; if not, three content fields need it removed.
